exec: // Date helpers for the tests: {{today}}, {{today_m40d}} (40 days ago), {{today_p1d}}, {{year}}, {{year_m1}}, ...
const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; };
for (const n of [-1, 1]) pm.collectionVariables.set(`year_${n > 0 ? 'p' : 'm'}${Math.abs(n)}`, year + n);

pm.expect((b || []).some(y => ((y !== null && typeof y === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y)) && (JSON.stringify(y?.id) === JSON.stringify(V("listedId"))) && ((typeof y?.email === 'string' && new RegExp("^listed-", "").test(y?.email))) && (Array.isArray(y?.roles) && y?.roles.length === 1 && ((y?.roles?.[0] !== null && typeof y?.roles?.[0] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y?.roles?.[0])) && (JSON.stringify(y?.roles?.[0]?.id) === JSON.stringify(V("listedRoleId"))))))), " includes {\"id\": \"{{listedId}}\", \"email\": {\"$regex\": \"^listed-\"}, \"roles\": [{\"id\": \"{{listedRoleId}}\"}]}").to.be.true;

pm.expect((b || []).some(y => ((y !== null && typeof y === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y)) && (y?.email === "root@sonata.test") && ((Array.isArray(y?.roles) && y?.roles.some(y1 => ((y1 !== null && typeof y1 === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y1)) && (y1?.name === "ADMIN"))))))), " includes {\"email\": \"root@sonata.test\", \"roles\": {\"$has\": [{\"name\": \"ADMIN\"}]}}").to.be.true;
